policy: Five approved takes only. Shared temple bank and sliding doors; no per-temple recording variations.

sources.prompt: Hiraeth REVISION 01 R2 - Quiet hoverbike glide. Very quiet light anti-gravity cushion: thin soft airy exhale with a faint warm rounded electronic purr. Intimate, gentle and unobtrusive beneath footsteps and dialogue, like a barely audible background texture. Extremely restrained low-mid energy. No bass rumble, roar, revving, sharp whine or impact. Steady seamless loop; no start, stop, pass-by, music or voices.

Hiraeth REVISION 02 R2 - CRT hologram startup. One small old CRT television powering on as a friendly hologram. Soft rounded power-button thunk, brief gentle degaussing whoom, delicate dry electrostatic fizz, then a thin rising electronic whine settling into a tiny hum and fading. Recognizable cathode-ray startup: warm, nostalgic, tactile and restrained. No notification chime, glass droplets, harsh screech, speech or music.

Hiraeth REVISION 03 R2 - Grand magical chest opening. A grand enchanted treasure chest slowly opens over five seconds. Deep soft seal release grows into a luminous ascending cascade of warm magical tones and shimmering air, blooming into a rich wondrous reveal and graceful tail. Memorable fantasy-adventure treasure ceremony, expansive and exciting. Original sound design, no existing game melody, wooden creak, metal squeak or speech.

Hiraeth REVISION 04 R2 - Magical key unlocking. One sustained three-second enchanted unlocking gesture for an ancient futuristic sliding door. Soft key contact begins a warm liquid-energy swirl; luminous resonances rise as the lock recognizes the key, then a rounded satisfying harmonic release and gentle tail. Deliberate, mysterious energy rather than machinery. No pin clicks, ratchet, metal scrape, clunks, short beep, door movement or speech.

Hiraeth TEMPLE 10 R1 - Quiet temple ambience. Isolated polished game sound for Hiraeth. Seamless quiet interior ambience for a serene ancient futuristic temple. Soft broad airflow through stone corridors, distant low warm energy resonance, extremely faint irregular dust-like tinkling. Spacious but restrained, no identifiable melody or rhythm, no voices, footsteps, water, sudden events or horror drones. Stable gentle loop.
